settings.title: System Settings
settings.description: Site, security, storage and integrations, languages and advanced parameters in one place

reason.sendFailed: Sending failed; check the settings and server logs
reason.robotNotFound: Robot not found; set its name first

site.title: Site information
site.description: Site name, logo, copyright and default language
site.logoUploadHint: A transparent horizontal logo at least 64px tall works best.
site.watermarkHint: Overlay the username and time on pages

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: Choose the cache backend; Valkey suits multi-instance deployments

storage.title: File storage
storage.readonlyHint: File storage is determined by config/config.yaml on the server (storage.driver / storage.s3.*) and is read-only here. Edit the file and restart the service to change it. The setup wizard and init --config write these values.

ai.title: AI model
ai.hint: If not configured, all AI entry points are hidden automatically
ai.redactHint: Phone numbers, emails, ID card numbers and bank card numbers are replaced with placeholders before being sent to the model and are not restored in the result. Keeping this on is recommended

sms.title: SMS
sms.description: Provider used to send verification codes and other messages
sms.logWarning: "Log only" just writes message content to the server log and sends nothing. Do not use it in production.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.description: Lock accounts after repeated wrong passwords and cap sign-in sessions so shared devices don't stay signed in
security.maxAttemptsHint: The account is locked once this count is reached
security.lockMinutesHint: Sign-in is blocked while locked; an admin can unlock it in User management
security.idleMinutesHint: Require sign-in again after this long without activity; each visit restarts the timer
security.maxHoursHint: Measured from the moment of sign-in; sign-in is required again when reached, however active you are

auth.title: Sign-in methods
auth.matchByHint: Existing users are matched by this field after third-party sign-in
auth.autoCreateHint: Create a new account when no user matches
auth.allowedDomainsHint: Separate multiple domains with commas; leave empty for no restriction
auth.proxyHint: Used when reaching overseas services such as Google and GitHub

notify.title: Notification channels
notify.description: Email (SMTP) and group robots; SMS uses the SMS section
notify.hint: Business messages can be delivered by email, SMS or group robots. Forgot-password relies on the email channel and is hidden on the login page until email is configured.
notify.robotSecretHint: DingTalk signing / Feishu signature secret; not needed for WeCom
notify.accountMailHint: Email the user when an account is created or an admin resets the password (never includes the password). Off by default.
